ui.heroLead: MMS has provided Male Massage Delivery for six years and is welcoming skilled professionals who want to choose suitable locations and working times across Thailand.
ui.modelTitle: MMS is looking for Model Therapists with genuine skills
ui.modelLead: This opportunity suits health professionals, physiotherapists, trainers, and experienced massage practitioners who are well-presented, communicate clearly, and respect agreed schedules.
ui.clientsTitle: Understand the client mix before applying
ui.clientsLead: Applicants choose the client scope they are comfortable with, and MMD confirms the details before every assignment.
ui.skillsTitle: Select only the skills you genuinely offer
ui.skillsLead: You may select more than one. MMD uses these skills when reviewing your application and coordinating suitable future assignments.
ui.formLead: This takes about 6–8 minutes. Enter accurate information and select your skills and preferred scope. Submitting an application does not guarantee engagement.
ui.contactHint: Provide at least a phone number or LINE ID.
ui.sensitiveExplanation: This sensitive information is stored separately, is not shown to clients, and is not used for assignment matching.
ui.sensitiveConsent: I consent to MMS storing my sexual orientation for the stated purpose.
ui.nationwideHint: Applications are open nationwide. Select 1–8 skills you can genuinely provide.
ui.uploadPrivacy: Attachments are optional and stored privately in R2 without a public URL.
ui.generalConsent: I confirm the information is accurate and consent to MMS using it for review, selection, and coordination.
ui.successLead: The MMS team will review it and contact you using the details provided.
